digest.component_or_area: lint gate, shell script static analysis
propositions: ShellCheck must be integrated into make lint at warning severity to detect SC2115 (glob expansion hazard in rm -rf patterns) on all tracked shell scripts excluding vendored directories
SC2115 is emitted at warning level; a gate configured at -S error would not catch the unsafe rm -rf "${dir}"/* pattern that caused a real filesystem incident
Nine pre-existing ShellCheck findings across two files must be cleared: either genuinely fixed or justified with targeted line-scoped disables, not blanket suppressions
The gate must fail-closed when ShellCheck is absent and clearly name the installation path and dependency (shellcheck-py), rather than silently skip
The unsafe pattern rm -rf "${dir}"/* must fail with SC2115, while the hardened form (: "${dir:?}" + cd -- "$dir" && rm -rf -- .*) must pass linting
